questions: Should the function handle Wikipedia disambiguation pages or redirects, and if so, how? Should it follow redirects automatically, or treat them as errors?
What specific exceptions from wikipedia.page() should cause a return of None? Only wikipedia.exceptions.PageError? Or any Exception (including network errors, DisambiguationError, etc.)?
What parameters (e.g., width, height, colormap, stopwords) should be used for the WordCloud instance? Should any customization be applied?
Should the function close or reuse matplotlib figures between calls to avoid memory issues, or is that left to the caller?
Is the function expected to call plt.show() or just create the Axes without displaying?
What figure size (figsize) should be used? The reference uses (10,5), but is that mandatory?
Should the text be preprocessed (e.g., lowercasing, removing punctuation, numbers) before generating the word cloud?
If the word cloud is generated from empty text, should the Axes still be returned (with an empty image) or should it return None?
